## Summary
Establish Supabase project with initial DDL migration, typed clients (server + browser), BaseRepository with dual-write pattern, RLS policies, and .env.example for all required environment variables.

## User story
As a developer, I want a fully configured Supabase instance with typed clients and RLS policies, so that I can build features against a secure, type-safe data layer from day one.

## Why this matters
Without this foundation, no feature can persist data. Incorrect RLS policies expose FERPA-protected student data. Missing BaseRepository means every future story invents its own dual-write pattern, creating inconsistency and Neo4j sync bugs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Migration 0001_initial_schema.sql applies cleanly to a fresh Supabase instance
- [ ] `pnpm db:types` generates packages/db/types/database.generated.ts without errors
- [ ] createServerClient() connects using service_role key (server-side only)
- [ ] createBrowserClient() connects using anon key (client-side, RLS enforced)
- [ ] BaseRepository<T> enforces dual-write pattern (Supabase first, Neo4j second)
- [ ] RLS policies exist on all tables with student data
- [ ] .env.example documents all required environment variables
- [ ] All tables with KG counterparts have neo4j_synced_at + neo4j_sync_status columns

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 6 (G08) | BaseRepository enforces Supabase-first dual-write — Neo4j failure never blocks |
| AP-16 | Use generated Row<'table'> types from database.generated.ts — never hand-write interfaces |
| AP-17 | Use supabase.rpc() for multi-table atomic operations — never sequential .insert() |
| Data Layer | createServerClient() in API routes/RSC, createBrowserClient() in client components |
| Data Layer | RLS as security floor — app-level filters are extra, never sufficient |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- packages/db/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql
-- Core tables for Journey OS foundation
-- All tables include: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
--   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
-- Tables with KG counterparts include: neo4j_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ, neo4j_sync_status TEXT

-- institutions (multi-tenant root)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS institutions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- profiles (extends Supabase auth.users)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS profiles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions(id),
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('student', 'faculty', 'admin')),
  display_name TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- courses
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS courses (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions(id),
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  academic_year TEXT NOT NULL,
  neo4j_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- subconcept_lod_briefs (Rule 7: LOD briefs in Supabase, not Neo4j)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subconcept_lod_briefs (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  subconcept_id UUID NOT NULL,
  lod_level TEXT NOT NULL,
  brief_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- audit_log (FERPA compliance — append-only hash chain)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions(id),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  table_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_id UUID,
  payload JSONB,
  hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  previous_hash TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- RLS policies
ALTER TABLE profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE courses ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE subconcept_lod_briefs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE audit_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- After applying: pnpm db:types
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// packages/db/server.ts — server client pattern
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import type { Database } from './types/database.generated'

export function createServerClient() {
  return createClient<Database>(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!  // server-side only
  )
}

// packages/db/browser.ts — browser client pattern
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import type { Database } from './types/database.generated'

export function createBrowserClient() {
  return createClient<Database>(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!  // RLS enforced
  )
}

// packages/db/BaseRepository.ts — dual-write pattern (Rule 6)
import type { Database } from './types/database.generated'
type Row<T extends keyof Database['public']['Tables']> =
  Database['public']['Tables'][T]['Row']

export abstract class BaseRepository<T extends keyof Database['public']['Tables']> {
  // Supabase write FIRST, then Neo4j sync (failure logged, never blocks)
  async create(data: Partial<Row<T>>): Promise<Row<T>> {
    // 1. Supabase insert
    // 2. Neo4j sync attempt (catch + log on failure, set neo4j_sync_status='failed')
    // 3. Return Supabase row
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-16: Hand-written interface duplicating database schema
interface Course {
  id: string
  code: string
  title: string  // WRONG — use Row<'courses'> instead
}

// ✗ AP-17: Sequential .insert() for operations that must be atomic
await supabase.from('courses').insert({ ... })
await supabase.from('course_enrollments').insert({ ... })
// WRONG — use supabase.rpc() for atomic multi-table operations

// ✗ Data Layer: service_role key in browser code
// NEVER import createServerClient in a 'use client' component (FERPA violation)
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E01/E01-S01.infra.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'

const supabase = createClient(
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
  process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!
)

test('Acceptance: migration applies and tables exist', async () => {
  const tables = ['institutions', 'profiles', 'courses', 'subconcept_lod_briefs', 'audit_log']
  for (const table of tables) {
    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).select('id').limit(0)
    expect(error).toBeNull()
  }
})

test('Acceptance: generated types match schema', async () => {
  // pnpm db:types:check exits 0 if types match
  const { execSync } = await import('child_process')
  expect(() => execSync('pnpm db:types:check')).not.toThrow()
})

test('Acceptance: RLS is enabled on student-facing tables', async () => {
  const { data } = await supabase.rpc('check_rls_enabled', {
    table_names: ['profiles', 'courses', 'subconcept_lod_briefs', 'audit_log']
  })
  expect(data).toBeTruthy()
  for (const row of data!) {
    expect(row.rls_enabled).toBe(true)
  }
})

test('Acceptance: KG-counterpart tables have sync columns', async () => {
  const { data: columns } = await supabase
    .from('information_schema.columns' as any)
    .select('column_name')
    .eq('table_name', 'courses')
  const colNames = columns?.map((c: any) => c.column_name) ?? []
  expect(colNames).toContain('neo4j_synced_at')
  expect(colNames).toContain('neo4j_sync_status')
})

test('Negative: anon key cannot bypass RLS on profiles', async () => {
  const anonClient = createClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!
  )
  const { data } = await anonClient.from('profiles').select('*')
  // Should return empty (RLS blocks unauthenticated reads)
  expect(data).toEqual([])
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `supabase db reset` to drop all tables and re-apply from scratch
2. Delete generated types: `rm packages/db/types/database.generated.ts`
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
